fields.title: Remove recommended_next/Next Up from ticket board show to match ticket-mcp board_show parity

fields.implementation_summary: Removed recommended_next/Next Up/recommendation-driven Immediate Actions text from ticket board show (CLI JSON+human) so it matches ticket-mcp board_show, which never surfaced recommendations. board show now only reports board/WIP state; ticket next / ticket-mcp next_tickets remain the sole recommendation surface on both interfaces. Updated workflow-tools/ticket/src/cli/commands/board.rs and board/render.rs, and the affected integration_board_cli tests. Updated the cross-interface best-next-ordering spec (ec22fe34) accordingly.
